arguments.summary: Selected five executed Multifamily rent comps in Tampa within 1.72 miles of the subject and dated between 2026-02-05 and 2026-06-09. Effective net rents (client convention) range from 9.468 to 22.123 $/sf/year. Records were ranked by distance (then recency). Exclusions were due to missing gross expenses, missing TI/free rent, non-executed status, outside distance/date window, zero/missing rent, or evidence published after the 2026-08-31 cutoff. A duplicate source for Dogwood Point 1 was noted and not double-counted. A comp-grid XLSX with citations has been created.
limitations: Free rent assumed front-loaded at lease start as instructed; timing within a period is not otherwise modeled.
Undiscounted rent-only convention ignores present value and non-rent economics (parking, options, reimbursements).
Where rents were quoted monthly, they were annualized exactly (x12).
For gross leases, expense deductions were applied every month per instruction, including free months.
Later-dated or unsigned updates were intentionally ignored per cutoff and evidence rules; if new executed amendments exist post-cutoff, results may change.
